G47's readings, settled on A15's first instantiate window before any spec row is written (they apply G47 with G11, G20 and G45's readings, and change no rule): (1) an attack whose words name the work a call was for as what it makes room for, or the call's errand its hands left, shows the order in the members' words (ChronoTrigger 'for space for her'; eve 'couldn't find the eve logo'); (2) a call to defend is a call to place, G11's hold form, and can be the first end (eve); building back over a rival's work laid on the room's own is defence, P05's, not the second end (eagles); (3) where a call places the room's work by changing another room's work (drugs, bakchodi), or its answer reads the call's own placement as the attack with no other target (AyyMD), the first call holds both ends (J); a plan to place the room's colour that names no other work is a call to place only (AprilKnights); (4) an attack said to be under way at a post's hour is at that hour (buffalobills, G45 reading 12); (5) a proposal to the room to build is a call to start (factorio); (6) a NONPORTABLE line whose only call is itself over another work, or whose challenge names the other work before any call to place, is a particular not marked PO (europe, brasil). Next: A15-inst-spec-1.txt for window i430_000

G47's readings 7 to 10, settled on A15's second instantiate window before its spec rows are written (they change no rule): (7) a challenge that calls the room to answer a rival's work on the canvas and names no act against it is a call to the canvas, the first end, not an attack call (mexico 'hay que enseñarles'; brasil); (8) a line whose concepts show only calls or acts against another work, with no call to place the room's own, shows one end (ice_poseidon); the bound needs a call to place shown after the first attack (canucks, lakers); (9) a report that a member was already placing over another work, in the past ('Eu estava fazendo'), places the act only before the report (G45 reading 12), against reading 4's acts said to be under way now; (10) a call to paint over a figure that the record does not say was laid on the room's work is an act against another work (monero); clearing works the room names as intruders on its own place is defence, as eagles (farmcarrots). Revision before any write: brasil-063's row in A15-inst-spec-1 is reworded under readings 7 and 9 (the challenge is a call to the canvas, and the placement over Argentina's flag is reported as already begun, so it cannot be placed after the call); the line stays a particular not marked PO, and reading 6 now reads: a NONPORTABLE line whose only call is itself over another work (europe, onepunchman), or whose attack cannot be placed after the call (brasil), is not marked PO. Next: the brasil row, then A15-inst-spec-2.txt

G47's readings 11 to 17, settled on A15's third instantiate window before its spec rows are written (they change no rule): (11) a call by another room to the room's members to place the room's own work is the first end, as a kindred sub's call (starcitizen, from r/EliteDangerous; its words show no edit, so it keeps the submission's hour by G45 reading 11); (12) a post whose call names its own placement over another work holds both ends, though it opens with a general call (startrek, as drugs and popheads); a reply by another member proposing the called work's placement over another work comes after the call (scotland, as Temple and bretagne); (13) an edit that adds an attack to a post places it after the post (utaustin 'The bomb must die'), as G46 reading 8 placed added help; (14) a room whose every call places its colour by covering what others built holds both ends in each call (theblackvoid 'We must CONSUME', J by reading 3); (15) play between the room's own sides ('Decepticons attack!!!' under the room's Autobot insignia) is not the room's act against another work (transformers, NA, as a taunt); (16) a visitor's attack call that no member takes up, with no call to place, shows neither end (philippines, ONE); (17) an attack whose words name the called work's labour ('have half the work done already', spain) shows the order in words by reading 1, while naming only a place or an ease ('Easiest thing', scotland; 'Right on top of Radiohead', muse) does not.
